summary_en: 200 shares of OMT (100% acquisition, completing subsidiarity). Deal price non-disclosed per mutual agreement; below 15% of net assets threshold. Contract signed July 15, 2026; share transfer execution August 1, 2026. Funded by internal cash. FY3/27 impact negligible.
summary_jp: OMT株200株取得（完全子会社化）。取得価額は相手先合意により非開示；純資産額の15%未満。契約締結2026年7月15日、株式譲渡実行2026年8月1日。自己資金充当。FY3/27業績への影響は軽微。
